queries.title: BEP thermoneutral barrier is one eighth of the Stokes shift
queries.chemicalQuestion: In the shared equal-curvature two-parabola model, is the BEP activation barrier at thermoneutrality one eighth of the optical Stokes shift computed from the same reorganization energy?
queries.chemicalRationale: BEP reads the model kinetically: the barrier at x = 0 is the reactant surface at the two-parabola crossing. StokesShift reads the same displaced parabolas optically: vertical absorption minus vertical emission is 2*lam. The thermoneutral barrier is lam/4, so the two theory-owned descriptors are linked by the factor 1/8. The query asks whether the kinetic and optical readings report the same reorganization energy, not whether two notations look alike.

sharedContext.physicalReading: Equal-curvature two-parabola step read both kinetically (BEP barrier at x = 0) and optically (vertical absorption minus vertical emission). lam is the reorganization energy shared by both readings; e00 is the 0-0 energy that cancels from the Stokes shift.

queries.title: Is the Förster transfer rate an activated BEP process?
queries.chemicalQuestion: Is the Förster resonance energy-transfer rate an activated elementary-step rate whose barrier is the BEP activation barrier at the same driving force?
queries.chemicalRationale: Förster transfer is a through-space dipolar process with an R^-6 distance law and no reaction coordinate; BEP is an activated crossing with a reorganization energy and a driving force. The two models share no energy coordinate, and a translation from (tauD, r6, R) to (lam, x) is not a coordinate change of the declared model. The question is outside the declared jurisdiction, not logically false.
